head: def15979b
method: E2EStressCommand foodking:e2e:stress · 5 attempted soak runs · single Laravel artisan serve process (PID 94396) · MySQL + Redis (predis) · monitor tick cadence ~20s · server RSS sampled via ps -o rss=

duration.note: Original prompt asked for ~30 min compressed soak; actual signal complete in 5 min because all 100-burst paths were rejected at edge by rate-limiter or FormRequest, before reaching the controller. The rejection itself is the cumulative-pressure signal — see finding F2-OBS-01.

deltas.note: All non-zero deltas (+6 orders, +19 outbox, +12 stale outbox) were produced by parallel agents F.10/F.11/F.1 running concurrently per the Phase F orchestration brief. F.2 itself created 0 orders, 0 audit_log entries, 0 fiscal_sequence_no allocations because every soak request was rejected at middleware/FormRequest gate before reaching the controller. The audit_logs delta of 0 is therefore the true F.2 contribution to system state.

nf525_chain_post: CHAIN OK (audit_logs + z_reports) (branch=1) | count=65 (bit-identical, no append)

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: Rate limiter holds under burst — production-equivalent finding
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: kiosk-orders bucket (60/min local · 5/min prod default keyed by kiosk:<user>|<ip>) saturated within ~2s of a 100-request burst from a single freshly-provisioned kiosk fixture. 100% rejection with HTTP 429 + JSON {message,retry_after} as specified. RouteServiceProvider:60-71. Recovery: 60s window rollover. This is the bouncer working AS DESIGNED — no production exposure. Real-world legitimate cashier burst (~10/min) sits well inside the cap.

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: E2EStressCommand POS payload stale — 4 required fields missing
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: minimalPosOrderPayload() docblock literally says "best-effort baseline" but missed: is_advance_order, source, pos_payment_method, pos_received_amount, AND PosController requires quote_token+quote_signature pair (not just a kiosk requirement). One scope-minimal repair shipped during F.2 (added is_advance_order=0, source=POS, pos_payment_method=CASH, pos_received_amount=1000, real items array). The quote-token path requires deeper refactor — V1.0.2 backlog: extend minimalPosOrderPayload + fetchPosQuote helper mirroring fetchKioskQuote.
cumulative_degradation_detected.action: V1.0.2 backlog item — add fetchPosQuote helper to E2EStressCommand.

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: No PHP server memory leak under burst
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: 14 RSS samples of artisan-serve PID 94396 over 5 minutes of mixed-rejection burst: baseline 51040 KB → peak 56352 KB (+5.2 MB during sustained burst) → settled final 48448 KB (-2.5 MB net vs baseline). Heap reclaimed after pressure. No monotonic-growth signature consistent with listener accumulation, idempotency cache unbounded growth, or cache fragmentation in PHP heap.
cumulative_degradation_detected.caveat: PHP built-in dev server is single-process+per-request. Production php-fpm worker dynamics differ — same test against prod stack remains required for full attestation.

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: Cache::lock fiscal-allocator contention surface NOT EXERCISED
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: Because every F.2 soak request was rejected before reaching OrderService, the NF525 Cache::lock 5s + DB FOR UPDATE triple-defence was NOT touched. F.2 cannot attest to fiscal_sequence_no allocation latency drift or contention under burst. The CI RushMidiSimulationTest suite (tests/load/RushMidiSimulationTest.php @group stress) covers structural monotonicity under sqlite-memory and remains green per BRAIN, but is not a true MySQL+Redis HTTP-path burst test. Wave Polish Final memory claims "Stress artisan 50/3/7s PASS" — that signal is the closest available attestation but predates this session.
cumulative_degradation_detected.evidence: audit_logs delta=0 + fiscal_sequence_no delta=0 (no allocation events from F.2)
cumulative_degradation_detected.action: Tied to F2-OBS-02 — once E2EStressCommand POS path can persist orders, rerun for fiscal-allocator contention signal.

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: Outbox pre-existing backlog persists; not aggravated by F.2
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: Baseline outbox_pending=751 (persistent dev-box backlog noted by CLAUDE.md C8 finding at ~742). Post-soak 770 (+19 from parallel agents F.10/F.11/F.1). Stale-30s went from 751 to 763 (+12). F.2 contribution: 0. Outbox not stuck-stuck; producers add events at expected rate. Lack of `queue:work` daemon is a known dev-box gap — production cutover requires the worker. Pre-existing 751 must be subtracted from any future soak's outbox delta math.

cumulative_degradation_detected.title: Zero 5xx · zero connection refused · zero timeouts under burst
cumulative_degradation_detected.summary: Across 5 soak attempts × ~120 total requests, observed status: 100 × 429 (kiosk rate-limit), 118 × 422 (POS validation, decreasing as fixes applied), 3 × 401 (POS quote-token). Zero 500-class. Zero socket errors. Zero timeouts. The system rejected gracefully at every guard it owns. DB connection pool, Redis pool, Sanctum token validation all held under the burst.

expected_concerns_addressed.cache_fragmentation: NOT MEASURED — no Cache::lock activity from F.2. Documented as gap (F2-OBS-04). RSS proxy GREEN (no PHP-heap fragmentation signature).
expected_concerns_addressed.listener_accumulation: NOT MEASURED — no controller hits. RSS proxy GREEN.
expected_concerns_addressed.memory_leak: GREEN — server RSS settled BELOW baseline (-2.5 MB net).
expected_concerns_addressed.outbox_stale: PRE-EXISTING — see F2-OBS-05. Not aggravated by F.2.
expected_concerns_addressed.fiscal_sequence_latency_drift: NOT MEASURED — see F2-OBS-04. CI suite still green.
expected_concerns_addressed.idempotency_key_cache_growth: NOT MEASURED — 0 successful POSTs from F.2 means 0 X-Idempotency-Key cache entries from F.2. Cannot attest.

verdict_rationale: GREEN on the four measured surfaces (no memory leak, NF525 chain bit-identical, no 5xx under burst, rate limiter graceful). AMBER overall because the cumulative-pressure surfaces of greatest concern (Cache::lock fiscal allocator + idempotency cache growth + listener accumulation) WERE NOT EXERCISED — every request was rejected before reaching the controller. F.2 cannot deliver a true production-equivalent burst attestation in this session without E2EStressCommand POS-path payload+quote-token repair (V1.0.2 backlog, F2-OBS-02). The kiosk-orders 429 finding is itself a positive production-relevant signal: the bouncer holds. No RED conditions: duplicate_fiscal=0, duplicate_queue=0, cross_branch_leak=0, chain OK.
